descriptionChirho: The proper name Bezalel (Hebrew בְּצַלְאֵל, 'in the shadow of God'), referring to (1) the chief artisan of the Tabernacle, son of Uri of the tribe of Judah (Exodus 31, 35-38), and (2) a post-exilic Israelite who put away his foreign wife (Ezra 10:30). All three clusters are the same name in different syntactic positions: subject/object forms, variant transliterations (Betsalel, Betsal'el, Bezalel), and conjunction-prefixed (and Betsalel). Cross-linguistically uniform: Spanish Betsalel/Betzalel, Arabic بَصَلْئِيل (Basalil), Korean 브살렠/브살렐 (Beusallel), Swahili Betsaleli/Besaleli, Hindi बसलेल/बसलएल (Basalel).
